responsibility: Implements tree-level profile instrumentation, profile-data use, and related gcov/value-profiling support across functions. It creates the gcov helper declarations and TLS state used by profiling runtime calls, instruments CFG edges and value sites, reads and applies profile information when available, handles thunks and source-file filtering, performs value-profile transformations on profiled code, and rebuilds CFG/SSA/cgraph state after instrumentation or profile-driven updates in the IPA profiling pass.
